text:
maya: Deploy window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Planning microwindow for API/runtime/console/router. Pinned variants: api@v2.4.1, runtime@v3.0.0-rc2, console@stable-2026-03, router@sha:ab12ef. Any blockers?
trent: Quick note: runtime rc2 still has intermittent KV eviction spikes on long seq tests. We ran a 30m soak, saw 2 spikes @ ~10ms increase in p95. Recommend canary 5% with health checks.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: wave=microwindow-2026-03-24, canary=5%, start=2026-03-24T02:00:00Z, rollback_on=metric:latency.p95>200ms for 5m
rachel: Release notes live: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RELEASE-2026-03 (console UX tweak + API header split). Tagging QA.
samir: Ops: For pinning, we should add emergency fallback to api@v2.3.9 and runtime@v2.9.8 (quantized) in routing policy. Live traffic fallback if canary fails.
maya: @samir agree. Add routing policy in ORCH config: ```routes:
  - service: api
    preferred: api@v2.4.1
    fallback: api@v2.3.9
  - service: runtime
    preferred: runtime@v3.0.0-rc2
    fallback: runtime@v2.9.8
```
trent: :eyes: I'll run one last KV eviction smoke against rc2 with longer sequences. ETA 45m.
rachel: Console change requires a schema migration for route metadata; migration runs online but needs 5m quiesce window. Can we schedule migration at 02:05 during canary pause?
maya: Yes. Plan: start deploy 02:00 canary 5% → pause at 02:05 for console migration (5m) → resume canary to 30% if metrics stable → 100% at 02:20. Manual rollback window until 02:30.
deploy-bot: Canary progress update: 5% started 02:00:30Z. Health OK. Telemetry link: https://telemetry.internal.redwood/microwindow-2026-03
samir: Add explicit rollback criteria in release notes: - API 5xx rate >0.5% sustained 3m - Runtime p95 > 200ms sustained 5m - Error budget burn > 5%
trent: If KV eviction reproduces, immediate rollback to runtime@v2.9.8. We should prepare a hotfix patch if logs show layer-x timeout.
maya: Assigning rollback captain: @trent. Oncall: @samir. Release owner: @maya. Everyone please monitor #deploy-alerts.
rachel: One more: update console feature flag toggle so we can disable UX tweak without redeploy if needed. I'll have a toggle ready by EOD.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 30% at 02:15:10Z. Metrics: latency p95 +2ms, errors flat. No rollbacks triggered. :thumbsup:
maya: If all good, I'll sign off for 100% at 02:20. Hold pins until final handback. Please leave short status updates here.
trent: Smoke done. No eviction reproduction in extended run. Ready to give rollback notice clear in 15m.
samir: Prepared routing config and fallback ready in infra. If rollback needed, command: ```deploy rollback microwindow-2026-03-24 --to runtime@v2.9.8 --force```
maya: Signed off. Proceed to 100% at 02:20, watch for 15m. Good luck. :shipit:
